sonnet.problem: Card 4 already asks whether Mary is found to be with child before she and Joseph come together, and its statement is the answer. Card 5 repeats that same fact in its question and asks about verse 18 again, so one point gets two questions.
sonnet.rule: An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact. Two lines that make the same point get one question. An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.

sonnet.problem: Card 8 already tells that the angel of the Lord appears to Joseph after he ponders. Card 9's True statement repeats that and adds only 'in a dream', so it is nearly a repeat of the card before it.
sonnet.rule: A True statement never just repeats the card before it.
